name: RC-B10-0133/2024 – § 10 – Am 1
title: Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
part_text: 10.Calls for the EU to end its reliance on gas exports from Azerbaijan; regrets the fact that the President of the Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, has characterised Azerbaijan as a ‘trustworthy energy supplier’; calls on the Commission to suspend the 2022 memorandum of understanding on the strategic partnership in the field of energy and to act accordingly;
